sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Civil Engineer (CREA) · MBA in Project Management (PMBOK) · 4+ years in offshore/marine operations, project execution and operational support in Brazil.
3y5m as Marine Operations Superintendent, integrating projects and operations across multiple ports with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, clients and international management.
Deepwater/offshore exposure: 18 months onboard pre-salt drillships plus OSV/FPSO support; fluent Portuguese and English in multicultural environments.
Strong HSSE and continuous-improvement background: risk assessment, incident investigation, corrective actions, KPIs, forecasting and operational readiness.

lead.title: Career Break (2024–Present)
lead.body: Family-support period while remaining professionally active through web/software and community projects. Immediately available for full-time return.

bullets: Coordinated marine project execution across multiple Brazilian ports, integrating vessels, terminals, suppliers, clients and international management.

Managed scope interfaces, services, measurements, costs and claims while supporting safe and reliable operational readiness.
Worked with QHSE on risk assessments, procedures, incident investigations and corrective actions under NORMAM/IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL requirements.
Consolidated production, availability, downtime and fuel KPIs into forecasts and management reports for clients and global leadership.
Planned offshore maintenance/cleaning campaigns supporting OSVs and FPSOs: crews, materials, deadlines, readiness and daily execution follow-up.
Coordinated contractors and operational interfaces for Shell, Transocean and Helix; supported deliverables, measurements, costs and contract control.
Used Petrobras Drake/SAP RT for compliance and logistics; produced DPR/RDO reporting and supported operational data consolidation.
Mapped internal processes and supported ISO 9000 implementation, strengthening management systems and continuous improvement.
Supported offshore and port operations, contractor mobilisation, transport requests, documentation and DRAKE credentialing for Tier-1 clients.
Spent 18 months onboard ultra-deepwater drillships, translating SOPs and technical communication across multinational offshore teams.
International engineering research with rigorous data collection, technical analysis and multidisciplinary collaboration.
